subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Yashiro Commission to ask about the Test of Courage

400890103.text: Ah, it's you two. Yes, it has been a while.

400890104.text: Hehe, we heard the Yashiro Commission is holding a Test of Courage, so we came right over to sign ourselves up!

400890105.text: We didn't expect to see you here in person, though. Does that mean this event is really important?

400890106.text: You think I only make an appearance for occasions that are deemed sufficiently important? Hehe.

400890107.text: It just so happens that this Test of Courage event was actually my suggestion, but naturally, I've left the planning and more trifling details to be arranged by my retainers.

400890108.text: Considering that such events are quite popular across Teyvat, I've had numerous examples to draw from, so everything should be in good order. I'm merely here to do a routine check on the progress of the event, that's all.

400890109.text: Oh, Paimon gets it... so what you're saying is you're not very busy right now.

400890110.text: In that case, maybe you can give us a quick rundown of the event rules!

400890111.text: Heh, only Paimon could be so natural at ordering others around.

400890112.text: However... the possibility remains that we may yet require your assistance.

400890113.text: Uh, sorry? What did you say?

400890114.text: Ah, nothing. Hehe, seeing as I apparently have some time, I suppose we may chat about the event for a moment.

400890117.text: As its name implies, the event is a game designed to put one's courage to the test.

400890118.text: The venue for the event will be set up in the Chinju Forest. Before the start of each round, participants will be divided into teams of two.

400890119.text: Once teams have been formed, the event staff will announce the name of an item that has been placed in or around the Chinju Forest area.

400890120.text: The first person to locate the specified item will be declared the winner of that round.

400890121.text: "The winner of that round"? Huh, so there's gonna be multiple rounds to the Test of Courage?

400890122.text: Precisely. There will be a total of three rounds in the Test of Courage because the event was actually orchestrated by three different parties.

400890123.text: Merchants raised event funding, the Kamisato Clan provided the grounds, and the Grand Narukami Shrine provided consulting services.

400890124.text: As such, each of these three parties have selected one item for participants to find, so naturally, the event will require three rounds to determine the winners.

400890125.text: Ah, Paimon gets it. So basically, it boils down to searching for stuff in Chinju Forest.

400890126.text: We'll need to find one item each round, for a total of three items after three rounds. Simple enough for Paimon!

400890127.text: Yes, seems you've got the gist of it. We will be issuing different rewards based on the number of rounds won, so if a participant wins multiple rounds, then that will also be reflected in their final reward.

400890128.text: If a participant manages to find all three items, then they shall receive the grand prize provided by the Grand Narukami Shrine.

400890129.text: Oh, a grand prize! Sounds like it could be really valuable!

400890130.text: As for its true value, I'm afraid you'll have to win the event first and ask Lady Guuji yourself.

400890131.text: Of course, this event is intended to measure your courage. If you withdraw from the event because you become too frightened, then you might as well forget about seeing any rewards.

400890132.text: I'm curious myself how many people will be brave enough to make it to the end. It'll be most disappointing if nobody claims the prizes we've prepared.

400890133.text: Don't worry, those prizes are as good as ours!

400890134.text: #Even though just the thought of this event sends shivers down Paimon's little spine, {NICKNAME} will be brave enough, no doubt about that!

400890136.text: I appreciate your enthusiasm. Hehe, I look forward to seeing how you perform.

400890139.text: Anyway, I think I've given you sufficient details. I'll add your names to the list of participants momentarily.

400890140.text: As for the three items you'll be searching for, please wait for a staff member to inform you at the start of the event.

400890141.text: Oh, and a friendly word of advice... Test of Courage events tend to give rise to a variety of strange rumors and stories, so please, be sure to exercise caution.

400890142.text: Whoa! What did he mean by that!? Oh, will there be spooky things in Chinju Forest?

400890138.text: No need to be so modest. Your journey thus far already speaks volumes of your bravery.

400890301.text: Alright, this looks like the place.

400890302.text: Uh, is it just Paimon, or does it look a lot scarier than usual here?

400890305.text: Argh! Don't sneak up on Paimon like that! What do you want?

400890306.text: Ah nothing, I just had a thought occur to me.

400890307.text: I want to scare the gang members real good, but now that I think about it, I've never actually scared anyone before.

400890309.text: So you mean you want to practice first?

400890310.text: Practice? Oh, now there's an idea.

400890311.text: Hey, I've got it! Why don't you join the Test of Courage like everyone else, and I'll go hide and try to scare you from time to time?

400890312.text: Then, you two can judge my scaring skills. Alright, that's the plan. Lemme go get ready!

400890313.text: Just wait, you'll see how scary this oni can be! Hahaha!

400890314.text: And there he goes, running off and still talking to himself...

400890315.text: Well, we were here to join the event anyway. Guess we'll just have to pass Itto's little "test" along with whatever else the event throws at us.

400890316.text: Oh, seems one of the event staff is over there. Let's go talk to her.

400890201.text: Hold it right there! Haha, well if it isn't my compadres! Didn't expect to see you here.

400890202.text: Huh, Paimon knows that voice... It's Itto! What are you doing here?

400890203.text: Wait, don't tell Paimon that you're here for the Test of Courage.

400890204.text: Hah, what else! I'm sorry, but those prizes already belong to yours truly... Arataki "Ain't Scared of Nothin'" Itto!

400890205.text: I mean, well, that's what I really wanna say... But uh, I've actually got something else goin' on.

400890207.text: Ah, it's a long story. As soon as I heard about the Test of Courage, I got the gang together and was ready to bring everyone for the time of their lives.

400890208.text: But uh, it turns out the other members weren't as pumped about the event as me...

400890209.text: "Chinju Forest? We've already been there a million times. There's nothing scary about that place!"

400890210.text: "That event's just a game for kids! What a waste of time... Let's play some Genius Invokation TCG!"

400890211.text: "Seriously, Test of Courage!? Ugh, whatever. I guess if that's what the boss wants..."

400890212.text: Can you believe that!? What a group of deadbeats... I'm not gonna put up with that, nuh-uh, not in my gang!

400890213.text: Oh, Paimon gets it now... dragging the gang to an event they don't want to go to won't be the best for your reputation as a leader.

400890215.text: As leader of the Arataki Gang, it's my duty to find new and tantalizing experiences for everyone. A happy gang means a happy life!

400890216.text: Even if they can't get it through their stubborn heads now, one way or another, I'll show them how much fun a Test of Courage can be!

400890219.text: Anywayyy, I'm no stranger to Chinju Forest. Sure, it was a little terrifying going through there, but hey, I'm used to it now!

400890220.text: And seriously, what kind of scary pranks could those guys in the Yashiro Commission ever come up with? If they can't scare anyone, then it's not gonna be a "test of courage" now, is it?

400890221.text: Not to mention, if the gang starts complaining... I won't ever be able to show my face around here.

400890222.text: And after all that talk, it still boils down to you!

400890223.text: Ah, well, leading a gang can be complicated. You don't understand... Anywho, I've got a plan.

400890224.text: Since there's no way I can trust the Yashiro Commission to make a fun event, I've decided to step in and spice things up a little.

400890225.text: Wait, you don't seriously mean that...

400890226.text: Oh, you bet I do! Yours truly is gonna be out scaring people! Hahaha, I'm taking this event to a whole 'nother level!

400890227.text: But it's gonna take more than an oni to make it happen... So I came here to recruit some help, and then I saw you come walking along.

400890228.text: C'mon! Come scare people with me, please!

400890233.text: Ugh, fine! But don't forget, we're here to win the Test of Courage and take home the grand prize.

400890234.text: We'll help you out. Just don't get in the way of our prize.

400890235.text: Hahaha, yes! You're a real oni saver! Don't worry, with me around, winning the Test of Courage will be a piece of cake.

400890236.text: Alright, those participants won't scare themselves! Let's get out there, hahaha!

400890237.text: What a noisy guy... Hmm, but after hearing him laugh and talk, Paimon doesn't feel scared anymore.

400890238.text: Huh, maybe laughter is the key to making fear go away! If things get scary later, we can all start laughing at the top of our lungs!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the site of the Test of Courage

400890502.text: Huh, it's Ayaka! Are you here for the Test of Courage, too?

400890503.text: Yes, my brother told me that the event would be "most interesting," and suggested that I personally participate.

400890504.text: I have never experienced a Test of Courage event, so I don't really know what to expect.

400890505.text: Oh, so this is your first time?

400890506.text: To be frank, I'm no expert when it comes to the supernatural... I often worry that I haven't shown spirits proper respect and have brought shame upon my clan.

400890507.text: Oh, speaking of which, may I ask if the two of you are partners for the event?

400890508.text: Actually, the shrine maiden just told us that we only count as a single participant, however that works... so we're looking for a partner now!

400890509.text: Splendid. In that case, how would you like to be my partner?

400890510.text: I always feel at ease when you're by my side. Ah, but of course, please don't let me get in the way if you wish to participate with someone else...

400890512.text: Oh, you'd really like to? Then it's my honor... Or I suppose I should say, please pardon my inexperience.

400890513.text: And if I appear to be frightened, please promise not to laugh at me.

400890515.text: Sure, I understand. I'll be waiting for you here.

400890516.text: You may let me know if you need anything.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the site of the Test of Courage

400890401.text: Aha, you must be here to participate in the Test of Courage?

400890402.text: Yep, that's right! Uh, judging from your outfit, you must be one of the shrine maidens from the Grand Narukami Shrine!

400890403.text: That's right. Huh, I can already see a dark aura surrounding the two of you... Yes, truly ominous.

400890404.text: If you carelessly go running into the event, all it'll take is one little misstep and the darkness will swallow you up, hehehe...

400890405.text: Whoa! What's with the sinister laugh...? Is she really a shrine maiden?

400890406.text: Sure you don't want to back out? This is your last chance. I'll count it down... three... two... one. Welcome to the Test of Courage... Enter at your own risk.

400890407.text: Uh, was that the first test?

400890408.text: Sure, you could say that. You know, the most unfortunate tales always happen unexpectedly on just a normal, average day... just like today.

400890409.text: But no need to worry. Allay your qualms and suspicions... Everything was already set into motion the moment you two stepped into this place.

400890410.text: Just enjoy the calm before the storm... The first round is about to begin. Have you already decided on your partner?

400890411.text: Ah, you finally said something that Paimon can understand! Yep, the two of us will be partners! We always make the best team!

400890413.text: #But it appears your names were written together as a single participant... "{NICKNAME} and Paimon."

400890414.text: Which means, you'll have to find yourselves another partner in order to join the event.

400890416.text: Ugh, if only Itto hadn't gone running off on his own, we could have had a partner! Now what should we do?

400890417.text: As far as I know, there have been other participants who have yet to designate a partner. You could go ask around.

400890418.text: Just be sure to make it quick. If you don't have a partner by the time the event starts, then you'll be immediately disqualified!

400890419.text: Uh oh, we can't let that happen! Let's go see if we can find anyone to partner up with nearby!

subQuests.subQuestName: Pick a partner out of the three contestants

400890801.text: So, have you given it some thought?

400890803.text: Oh, you'd really like to? Then it's my honor... Or I suppose I should say, please pardon my inexperience.

400890804.text: And if I appear to be frightened, please promise not to laugh at me.

400890807.text: You may let me know if you need anything.

subQuests.subQuestName: Begin the first round of the Test of Courage

400891101.text: Ah, it looks like you've found yourselves a partner.

400891102.text: The event is just about to start. I will now reveal the item you'll be looking for in the first round.

400891105.text: Correct. Tomoki was kind enough to provide us with his Dango Milk and it has been hidden somewhere in the Chinju Forest.

400891106.text: The path will be marked with <color=#00E1FFFF>signs</color> to guide you, but some strange and unusual things may occur along the way... If you ever feel you can't handle it, you may withdraw from the event at any time.

400891107.text: Now, if you're ready, then you may begin.

400891108.text: We don't want anyone to beat us to it — let's go!

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete the first round of the Test of Courage

400891701.text: Look, everyone. Isn't this the Dango Milk we are searching for?

400891702.text: And there's a scarecrow beside it. Strange... What is that doing here?

400891703.text: Well, it doesn't matter now! Since we found the Dango Milk, then we must be the first ones here, right?

400891704.text: But there's no way we can carry back so much Dango Milk. Why don't we drink some to lighten the load a little?

400891705.text: Paimon could use a sip... Whaa!!! The scarecrow stood up!

400891706.text: It appears to be guarding the Dango Milk here...

400891707.text: You mean, it's watching if we touch the Dango Milk? Uh, don't worry, P—Paimon didn't even touch it!

400891710.text: Oh, maybe you're right, Paimon will try to calm down... Let's try some together!

400891711.text: You drink some Dango Milk with Ayaka...

400891713.text: Indeed. Any fears I had a moment ago seem to have been dissipated by the Dango Milk.

400891714.text: And now that I look around, this is Chinju Forest as I have always known it. After making it here, it doesn't seem nearly as frightening.

400891715.text: My brother once said that fear stems from one's heart, and if your heart is at peace, then fear naturally dissipates. Now I understand what he meant.

400891716.text: But fear is not entirely bad... Although I've been scared a few times, I still feel happy now.

400891717.text: I would like to continue walking through the forest for a while. Will you accompany me?

400891718.text: I think I saw someone I know just now...

400891719.text: Ah, I see. Well, I shall continue walking while you go greet your friend.

400891720.text: Don't worry. Now that I've experienced the event once already, I won't be easily frightened. I'll see you later. Have a lovely chat with your friend.

400891901.text: Hmm, it seems we'll be the first to find it.

400891903.text: I can sense a sweet aroma on the wind. The Dango Milk should be nearby.

400891904.text: Really!? Let Paimon have a look here... Oh, you're right! There it is!

400891905.text: Yippee! Who would've guessed we'd be the first ones! Hmm? But what's that scarecrow doing here?

400891907.text: Whaa!!! It... It's standing up! Is it alive!?

400891910.text: What? Oh, well it sure worked on Paimon!

400891911.text: But that should be the end of it... right? There doesn't seem to be anything else around here.

400891912.text: It seems the test wasn't as scary as I had anticipated. However, I have enjoyed the experience together with you.

400891913.text: Now that we've found the Dango Milk, we can head back the way we came.

400891914.text: What's the matter? Is there something over there?

400891915.text: I saw someone I know just now...

400891916.text: Ah, I see. So she is at the Test of Courage, too.

400891917.text: To avoid any unnecessary complications, I'd prefer not to meet with her. You may pass on my regards.

400891918.text: There is a lot of Dango Milk here. I'll take half of it back and leave the rest to you.

400892001.text: Have you found a partner yet?

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete the first round of the Test of Courage

400891801.text: *sniff* *sniff* That's the scent of Dango Milk — we've found it!

400891802.text: Oh! It really is Dango Milk! A lot of it, too.

400891803.text: And look, there's a scarecrow here. Now who could have knocked it over— Wh—Whaa!!! It's standing up!

400891807.text: Huh, really? Whew, that almost scared Paimon's socks right off.

400891808.text: Oh, looks like we managed to be the first ones here! Hehe, with so much Dango Milk, it wouldn't hurt if we drink a couple of bottles, right?

400891810.text: Everyone knows that Dango Milk spoils quickly if it's left out. Besides, we should try some!

400891811.text: You drink some Dango Milk with Gorou...

400891812.text: Mmm, that's delicious! I would like to buy some to bring back to Watatsumi Island.

400891813.text: I bet the troops would be happy to have such a good-tasting drink. It's unfortunate that it spoils easily...

400891814.text: Let's split the remaining bottles and start heading back. Ready?

400891815.text: I think I saw someone I know just now...

400891816.text: Oh, was it one of your friends? Do you need to go talk to them?

400891817.text: In that case, I don't want to get in your way. I'll take back the remaining Dango Milk. Maybe I'll run into you in the next Test of Courage round!

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete the first round of the Test of Courage

400891202.text: Whoa! It's really you! What are you doing here?

400891203.text: Oh, hello. Miko told me about the Test of Courage event taking place here. I thought I would come and have a look.

400891204.text: Ah, so that's why you're here. So, what do you think of the Test of Courage, are you having fun?

400891205.text: It's more or less the same as I remember before.

400891206.text: I wasn't scared by anything... But on the contrary, some of the event participants were horrified the moment they saw me.

400891207.text: Oh, that Miko! Did she send Ei here to scare people on purpose!?

400891210.text: If that's the case, it feels like Ei isn't really experiencing the event like everyone else...

400891211.text: Oh, Paimon has an idea! We'll give you a bottle of the Dango Milk we just found. That would make you a winner in this round, too!

400891212.text: Ah yes, isn't that the dessert drink we had the last time we met? Sure, I'll take one.

400891213.text: Actually, I've sensed a familiar feeling ever since I arrived here. It's brought some old memories to mind.

400891215.text: Have you been down to the beach by any chance?

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the site of the Test of Courage

400891301.text: So? What'd you think? Do I know how to scare people or what!?

400891303.text: Uh... Paimon was hiding behind you the entire time, so Paimon didn't really notice Itto scaring us at all...

400891304.text: #Uh, Paimon will leave this one to {NICKNAME}! So, was Itto scary or not?

400891306.text: What? No way! Listen, every time I made my move, I scared the living daylights out of everyone!

400891309.text: Even I had no idea I possessed such talent... But this is just what I needed to hear! Now I'll show 'em — the gang will know just how terrifying their leader can be!

400891310.text: Anyway, I already figured out which path they'll be taking, so let's wait nearby and scare the pants off 'em!

400891311.text: Hahaha, now things are getting interesting! You ready? We've got people to scare!

400891001.text: Do you need me to be your partner?

400891003.text: Very well, then. I wouldn't mind a walk together.

400891004.text: I haven't participated in many of these events, so I'm curious what new experiences lie ahead.

400891006.text: Sure, please don't worry about me.

400891007.text: The point of friends gathering is to have a good time. Worrying will only dampen the mood.

400891401.text: Shh... I think we're getting close.

400891402.text: C'mon c'mon c'mon!!! Can't let them see us!

400891403.text: Oh, here they come... So how are you going to scare them, Itto?

400891404.text: Easy peasy. We'll wait for them to get real close, and then we'll jump out and shout together. They won't know what hit them!

400891405.text: Huh? What're we, a bunch of kids now...?

400891408.text: Hey, don't underestimate me. It may sound simple, but I know exactly what will scare them.

400891409.text: The gang's probably moping along on their way back, saying things like, "this is boring" and "let's go home."

400891410.text: But it's dark and their guard is down — now's our chance. Having the three of us suddenly come flying outta the bushes is gonna scare 'em real good.

400891411.text: Before they come to their senses, we'll already be half-way to our next ambush spot!

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the people that ran away
Follow the people that ran away

400891501.text: Well, we've already walked all the way here...

400891502.text: Hmm, wonder where those three went... Paimon didn't see them anywhere.

400891503.text: Maybe Itto was right! Maybe they've been hiding. Seems like they're not scary after all!

400891506.text: Hey! Listen up, you three little wimps! Paimon can already see you guys, so just come out and show yourselves!

400891507.text: Waaaah!!! There's someone actually here! Paimon's scared again!

400891510.text: You can't give in to your desires... Others will suffer for it. You mustn't make the same mistake...

400891511.text: Just hold on a little longer... you've already come all this way, right?

400891512.text: Uh, excuse us. Did you happen to see three rascals pass by here? Let Paimon tell you what they look like...

400891513.text: Is it me, or does it look like she's burying something?

400891517.text: You have no business coming here. You shouldn't be anywhere near me...

400891518.text: If you value your lives, you must leave immediately. Otherwise, your souls will be trapped here forever.

400891519.text: I won't warn you again. Now, away with you... be gone...!

400891520.text: Wake up. Hey, Traveler... wake up!

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete the first round of the Test of Courage

400890602.text: #Ah {NICKNAME}, Paimon! I didn't expect to run into you here!

400890603.text: We're here for the Test of Courage! How about you?

400890604.text: Well... I was originally headed to Yae Publishing House to hand in responses for this month's issue of That's Life.

400890605.text: But I had no idea that that crafty fox would be there! She brought up the Test of Courage event and suggested I give it a try.

400890606.text: I wasn't interested, but she said, "The mighty general of Watatsumi Island isn't afraid of anything, is he?"

400890607.text: And before I knew it, I found myself caught in her persuasive mind games. *sigh* I immediately regretted it the moment I arrived here. There could be traps everywhere...

400890608.text: Oh, this event's sounding more and more dangerous...

400890609.text: My instinct tells me that the forest is chock-full of ambushes. One misstep and it'll be over.

400890610.text: Perhaps that crafty fox is hiding somewhere in the dark, waiting for another opportunity to tease me. Who knows, she might even use a Kamera and send embarrassing photos back to Watatsumi Island...

400890611.text: Her Excellency once said, "When you march into an ambush, escape the enemy vanguard. When escape is impossible, then seek ample reinforcements."

400890612.text: Hmm, now that you're here, maybe we can turn the tables. Could I ask you two to partner up with me?

400890614.text: Great! This'll be our chance to fight side by side once again!

400890615.text: With you around, there's nothing to fear! That crafty fox's games are over!

400890617.text: Oh, sure... I completely understand. Perhaps you have a friend you'd like to enter the Test of Courage with?

400890618.text: Anyway, whoever you decide to partner up with, the most important thing is to enjoy the event. Good luck!

400890701.text: There was a familiar scent upon the wind. I knew that I'd see you around here.

400890704.text: Paimon didn't expect to see you at the Test of Courage!

400890705.text: And why's that? Do I seem unsuited for this sort of event?

400890706.text: No, not at all! It's just that Paimon's never seen you get scared, Kazuha.

400890707.text: You're always so calm and collected. It's like you've never been scared by anything!

400890708.text: You flatter me. I suppose that's only a reflection of my time wandering the wilderness. I've heard many strange stories in my travels.

400890709.text: I can say I've even experienced a few myself. Over time, I must have gotten used to it.

400890710.text: Ah, that makes sense! But uh, why do you want to join the Test of Courage?

400890711.text: After hearing the Yashiro Commission promote the rewards for this event, I was guessing that you two would show up.

400890712.text: Since we hadn't seen each other for some time, I figured I might as well come and see you. After all, meeting someone after being apart for so long always lifts the spirits.

400890713.text: Oh, so you were waiting for us?

400890714.text: That's right. So, tell me, how has your journey been lately?

400890715.text: Things have gone pretty well! Uh, by the way, the shrine maiden told us that everyone needs a partner to participate in the Test of Courage event. Have you found a partner yet, Kazuha?

400890716.text: No, not yet. Do you need me to be your partner?

400890718.text: Very well, then. I wouldn't mind a walk together.

400890719.text: I haven't participated in many of these events, so I'm curious what new experiences lie ahead.

400890721.text: Take your time. We'll have plenty of chances to talk later, so there's no need to make a choice this very instant.

400890722.text: We could even go together for a late night snack once the event is over.

400890901.text: Oh, have you decided whether or not to participate with me?

400890903.text: Great! This'll be our chance to fight side by side once again!

400890904.text: With you around, there's nothing to fear! That crafty fox's games are over!

400890906.text: Oh, alright... To be honest, I was really looking forward to the chance of teaming up with you.

400890907.text: With the two of us fighting together, I feel like we could take on any enemy!

400891602.text: Shh! Please, not a word of this to anyone! Otherwise, they'll dock my pay.

400899601.text: This reminds me of a story that a retainer once told me several years ago.

400899602.text: There was a wandering samurai who, while crossing the forest at night, noticed that the familiar scenery was beginning to change right in front of him.

400899603.text: The man stopped and realized that it was as if he was in another world. Strange creatures that didn't appear to be human were all staring at him...

400899604.text: Whaa! That's super scary! Paimon doesn't even dare look at all these trees after hearing that story!

400899605.text: #Will we really be okay...? If anything weird jumps out at us, teach it a lesson, {NICKNAME}!

400899606.text: Hahaha! Oh, I'll show you how scary this oni can be!

400899611.text: Oh, they suddenly lit up! We'd better keep our distance!

400899614.text: Huh? Did you hear that voice?

400899615.text: Ah, the torment~... You will suffer with me~!

400899616.text: Could it be... a spirit that's haunting this place?

400899617.text: Oohhh~ We're not here to bother you, uh no need to torment us! We'll even ask someone at the Grand Narukami Shrine to come and free you... hehe!

400899618.text: Aww, Paimon thought we found it, but it doesn't seem to be here.

400899620.text: Have we reached the end? Paimon doesn't see anything here...

400899621.text: Seems we went the wrong way... Let's try a different path!

400899623.text: Would you like to stop for a rest?

400899701.text: Hmm... There's something off about this place...

400899702.text: This unsettling feeling reminds me of a strange story I heard among the troops.

400899703.text: A strange story? Is it... scary?

400899704.text: According to the story, there was an army that was marching through a deserted forest when they discovered a stockpile of delicious food.

400899705.text: The troops were short on provisions, so they came to a halt and began to eat heartily. Before long, they suddenly noticed several pairs of blood-red eyes staring at them...

400899706.text: Ahh! Paimon's heard enough! What a scary story... *whimper*

400899707.text: Hehe, just as I predicted! They're coming right our way!

400899708.text: It's time, Ushi! Let's give 'em a scare! Heeheehee.

400899709.text: A surprise attack! I can't see anything!

400899710.text: It's an ambush! Everyone, fall back!

400899714.text: It's fireworks... Whew, Paimon was scared half to death...

400899716.text: Huh? Who goes there? Identify yourself!

400899719.text: Oh, this is creeping Paimon out. Let's sneak by and stay out of sight...

400899720.text: There may be ambushes waiting in the forest. Let's stick to the road signs.

400899801.text: Uh, is it just Paimon, or does Chinju Forest feel a little gloomier than before?

400899802.text: I haven't sensed anything particularly different. How about I tell you a story...

400899803.text: Once, in my wandering travels, I came upon a bridge, and I had been told that an ominous presence awaited those who cross that bridge at night.

400899804.text: It was said that there were a pair of lovebirds who tragically fell into the water below and perished. Their grieving spirits converged around the bridge and were never dispersed.

400899805.text: So, I picked a night to cross the bridge, and as I was crossing, I heard some voices.

400899807.text: I stopped and listened for some time, and realized it was a couple disguised as ghosts who blackmailed passersby for their belongings. They were arguing over how to split their ill-gotten loot.

400899808.text: Huh, after hearing that, Paimon doesn't feel so scared anymore!

400899809.text: You have no idea how long we've been waiting here! Hahaha! Let's go, Ushi!!!

400899818.text: Huh, fireworks? Whew, Paimon was scared half to death...

400899821.text: I will haunt you... and you shall know my horror~!

400899827.text: I'm also curious about what's over there, but we should continue following the signs for now.

400899901.text: #Hey {NICKNAME}, you'll never guess what Paimon just heard!

400899902.text: The Yashiro Commission is holding a Test of Courage event! They've even prepared rewards for participants who can pass the event's challenges!

400899903.text: But uh, if it's a "Test of Courage," that means it's probably gonna be scary, right? So, if we join, Paimon's gonna let you go first...

400899904.text: You get separated from your partner during the Test of Courage
